# Vendored snapshot

- Upstream: https://github.com/Astyyyyy/fsr4-vk
- Commit: `b0125ea9798633750f83ebabbc00279bcb49d8dd` ("add more windows fp8 performance patches")
- License: GPL-3.0-only (see `LICENSE`)
- Vendored on: 2026-11-03

This is a source snapshot used as the reference implementation for the native
Linux FSR 4 port. The upstream git history and submodules are not included:

- `third_party/dxil-spirv`, `glslang`, `SPIRV-{Headers,Tools}`,
  `Vulkan-{Headers,Loader}` are empty submodule directories in this snapshot.
  They are only needed to build upstream's tools, not to read the runtime.
- The FSR 4.1.1 assets generated by upstream's `tools/setup.py` are not included;
  this port extracts 4.1.2 assets from the user's own signed DLL instead.
